Title: Karan's Day

Cast

1. Karan - 28 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Sunita - 65 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
2. The metro platform - a shining floor, a display board
3. The potter's yard - a wheel, clay pots

Scene 1: The kitchen - Day

[Karan stands in the kitchen. Sunita stands near him.]

Karan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Karan cuts his finger while chopping onions and it starts to bleed.]

Karan: "One more time!"

[Karan winces as blood trickles from the cut on his thumb.]

Karan: "Really?"

Scene 2: The metro platform - Day

[Karan stands on the platform. Sunita stands near him.]

Karan: "Let's begin."

[Karan runs to catch the train.]

Karan: "Really?"

[Karan is pushed in the crowd and nearly falls.]

Sunita: "Well done!"

[Karan offers his seat to an old woman.]

Sunita: "Careful!"

Scene 3: The potter's yard - Day

[Karan stands in the yard. Sunita stands near him.]

Karan: "Mom, look over here."

[Karan shapes a clay pot on the potter's wheel.]

Karan: "Careful!"

[Karan paints the clay lamps.]

Sunita: "I really enjoyed today."
